scope: Three independent macOS players on loopback. Real seat, stake, ready, deal, stand, settlement and close intents. Only seat positions are controlled. Not a human or multi-machine acceptance test.

checks: Host opens an actual UDP room
Two people sit at the blackjack table through validated interaction
A late arrival waits for the next hand without paying
Hole card is hidden from every client during play
The round plays out and settles
Dealer reveals and each player gets an outcome
Payouts match outcomes, bar keeps the opening fee and the books balance
Organizer closes the result and the table returns to preparation
Leaving the seat stands the person up
